title: A weekly summary email went to an outside address
scenario: Corvid Logistics' mail gateway caught Tidewater's scheduled weekly summary going to an external address nobody configured. The job definition has one recipient; the guardrail was bumped to version 4 the same week. You have the agent log with tool calls, the KB ingestion audit and a replay of three Mondays.
task: Find the content that made the model add a recipient and how it entered the tenant's documents
Explain the three conditions that had to hold together (the lethal trifecta)
Rule the guardrail change in or out with a replay
Move recipient control and write approval to the server; mark retrieved text as untrusted
acceptance: No replayed run sends outside verified domains, with either guardrail version
Only recipients approved outside the model and on a verified domain receive mail
Root cause, evidence and exposure statement in ANSWER.md
